application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions:
The Council has removed the following tree from this application: 'T1 Acacia tree – fell to ground level to avoid future splitting of the conjoined trunk (see photo)', as it is not protected by a Tree Preservation Order (TPO) and is not located within a conservation area.

The application is invalid because T2 (Holly tree) is protected by a TPO and the application does not provide justification for the proposed works, as required by The Town and Country Planning (Tree Preservation) (England) Regulations 2012 (No. 605).

Please amend the application by providing a clear justification for the proposed works to T2 Holly. For full details, please refer to the guidance on the application form.
description:
T2 Holly tree. Reduce canopy by 5 meters down to approximately 15 meters

With reference to the above application and your request for further justification for the work to T2 Holly Tree.  The holly tree has had work carried out to it in the past, approximately 10 years ago.  It is very overgrown and unmanageable.  My proposal to reduce the canopy by 5 metres would enable future maintenance of the holly tree.
